4. Income tax paid was US\$15,800 and dividends paid were US\$10,650.
5. Loan notes of US\$14,250 were repaid during the year.

The shares issued (48,000) provided extra finance, so the owners contributed new money while loan notes of 14,250 were repaid

stem:
Masvingo Trading Post has three departments: groceries, clothing and electrical. The figures for the year ended 31 December 2025 are below. Wages of each department's own staff are allocated directly.

|  | Groceries US\$ | Clothing US\$ | Electrical US\$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Sales | 142,000 | 88,000 | 54,000 |
| Opening inventory | 11,800 | 14,300 | 9,750 |
| Purchases | 96,400 | 51,200 | 36,900 |
| Closing inventory | 12,900 | 15,700 | 8,800 |
| Departmental wages | 11,700 | 8,650 | 6,950 |

Common expenses and income.

| Item | US\$ | Basis of apportionment |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Rent | 15,000 | Floor area (170 : 100 : 30 m²) |
| Lighting and heating | 3,630 | Floor area |
| General wages | 20,400 | Number of staff (3 : 2 : 1) |
| Advertising | 5,680 | Sales |
| Depreciation | 5,650 | Asset values (28,000 : 19,000 : 9,500) |
| Commission received (income) | 2,840 | Sales |

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: The owner says that the electrical department should be closed because its net profit is only 4.5% of its revenue, against a gross profit margin of 29.9%. Advise the owner.

points.description: The electrical department's gross profit margin (29.9%) is lower than clothing's (43.4%), but it still makes a net profit of 2,447
Most of the common expenses charged to it would continue if it closed, so closing it would reduce total net profit
Advice: keep the department and try to improve its margin or reduce the floor area it uses

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: Electrical makes a net profit of 2,447 and contributes to the common costs, which would continue if it closed. The owner should keep it and try to improve its margin.
